items.title: Server, Hermes, Forge pages
items.text: In the dashboard: admin buttons (as cards), Hermes's cap, drop files to convert.

items.title: See what Tiro read
items.text: A green box shows for a moment on what Tiro just looked at.

items.title: Asks before it looks or acts
items.text: Screenshots, reading an app, clicking, typing, opening: Allow once per app.

items.title: Tiro can reach this PC
items.text: Tiro on the server can talk, show a notice or set a reminder here.

items.title: Tiro Command
items.text: Chat with Tiro in the dashboard. It's the same chat as on your phone.

items.title: Hand off to Hermes
items.text: Say "Tiro, I'm heading out" and Hermes finishes it. The result goes to your phone.

items.title: Ask Hermes
items.text: Start with /hermes or "Hermes," to ask the Hermes agent.

items.title: Allow from the dashboard
items.text: Allow / Don't allow questions show in the dashboard too.

items.title: New icon
items.text: The tray and app icon are TiroDash's [T] mark now.

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: Open Dashboard in the tray menu: server health, activity, approvals.

items.title: A new look
items.text: Tiro now looks like the Tiro web app: dark slate, one cyan accent, clean panels.

items.title: Cleaner bubbles and cards
items.text: No more glow, glass or dither. Text is sharper and easier to read.

items.title: Green mic waveform
items.text: While I listen, four green bars show your voice.

items.title: All Tiro now
items.text: Tiro desktop is its own app, split from Roamies. Credit to Ken Kai on the About page.

items.title: Your settings moved
items.text: Settings, memory and logs now live in your .tiro folder. Nothing was lost.

items.title: Other looks
items.text: Roamies' other looks are gone. Tiro is the one look, with its own voice.

items.title: Focus and game mode
items.text: Focus blocks and the game sidebar were removed.

items.title: Mac and Linux
items.text: Tiro desktop is built for Windows only now.
